subject: joule operator standard operating procedure
opening: Operators run joule as a GUI-first local pool or multi-agent cluster: start control, donate with an agent under local policy, watch live capacity graphs, and ship only when cargo gates and the docs pack are green.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body: This SOP defines day-to-day operation of a joule lab or standing pool: quality gates, donor contribution control, live capacity visibility (CLI and GUI), and the release ship flow for f00-sh/joule.

sections.heading: 2. Day-to-day operator gates
sections.body: Before exposing any gateway or telling donors the pool is open, complete these checks in order. Fail closed on any red step.

steps.text: Confirm GUI Overview shows backends and connection state; Graphs zoom/pan work.

figure.title: GUI-first operator surface
figure.caption: joule version and GUI tab path (Overview / Graphs / Donor / Chat) after release build.

sections.heading: 3. Donor local controls (law 5)
sections.body: Remote operators cannot raise local caps. Agents reload the policy path passed with --policy. Schedule windows use OS local timezone (tm_gmtoff on Unix).
items: Pause/resume: joule donor pause|resume or GUI Donor tab / tray
VRAM cap: joule donor set-cap N (0 clears) or tray --donor-set-cap
Schedule / thermal / battery: donor policy JSON or GUI Donor tab
Status: joule donor status — prints local schedule and sensors

sections.heading: 4. Release ship flow
sections.body: Ship only when gates are green. Documentation pack is mandatory: CHANGELOG, file_id.diz, README, Pages, man, SOP PDF, this-version NASA memo PDF, SemVer tag, GitHub Release assets (CI on tag v*).

sections.heading: 5. Product laws (do not violate)
items: Compute is the only currency on the public pool — no money
Credits = sealed hash-chain millijoules only; verified VRAM only for mint/placement
Website is not a weight CDN — content-addressed peer seed only
